summary: "Addicted" is Ace Young's second single, following his 2006 song "Scattered". It was the first and only single from his self-titled 2008 CD. The song was written by Desmond Child and Andreas Carlsson and produced by Desmond Child.
one_line: "Addicted" is Ace Young's second single and the only one from his 2008 self-titled CD, written and produced by Desmond Child.
key_facts: Ace Young's first single was the 2006 song "Scattered".
"Addicted" is the first and only single from Ace Young's self-titled 2008 CD.
"Addicted" was written by Desmond Child and Andreas Carlsson.
Andreas Carlsson was part of the team who wrote for the Backstreet Boys.
